Summary:
Pranav Dulepet works on applied AI at Greenboard in New York City. He recently finished an M.S. in Computer Science at Johns Hopkins CLSP.

Current roles:
- Applied AI team at Greenboard.

Background:
- M.S. in Computer Science from Johns Hopkins University.
- B.S. (Honors) in Computer Science from the University of Maryland.
- Previous work at JHU CLSP, DataTecnica, Apple, Amazon, Fidelity Investments, Capital One, and Evozyne.

Research interests:
- Human-AI collaborative systems
- Large language models
- LLM reliability and evaluation
- NLP and biomedical NLP
- AI agents
- Benchmarking
- AI governance and policy
